images.caption: Main energy-transfer routes in half a C₂S₂M₂: LHCII → CP29/CP26 → CP43/CP47 → reaction centre

images.caption: Network model of PSII supercomplexes of four antenna sizes; red bars mark the energy-transfer contacts leading to charge separation
images.credit: Caffarri, Broess, Croce & van Amerongen 2011, Biophys J 100:2094, Fig. 1
